description.value: Comms in the wastes cut out constantly, and you've made that work for you more than once. You can Create a Diversion by claiming radio interference garbled your last transmission, affecting one additional creature within earshot at no increase to the DC.

cinderfall.incomplete: Expanding Create a Diversion to affect one additional creature at no DC increase changes the action's targeting scope, the same problem as Break the Room -- no rule element retargets an existing action.
